description: Type text (simulates keystrokes; appends). Target by ref from browser_snapshot (preferred), selector, or omit both to type into the focused element. Prefer over browser_fill for contenteditable/rich-text editors.

mode.description: "sequential" = per-key events. "insert" = bulk insertText, fast, safe for modal composers. "paragraphs" = Escape+Enter between paragraphs (never on modals — Escape closes them). See browser_cheatsheet for platform guidance.

nthMatch.description: If the selector matches multiple elements, type into the Nth (0-indexed).

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector — exact match, no guessing.

selector.description: Playwright selector for the element to type into. If both ref and selector are omitted, types into the focused element.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

text.description: The text to type character by character (appends to existing content).

textHint.description: Auto-heal: if the selector matches 0 elements, server retries with role=*[name~="<textHint>"].

name: browser_type
